items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: he would get me somebody called, uh, John Peniton, I think it is. He was a trombone player, but he couldn't play.

ctx.x: Jimmy, uh, Palau, I think? Yeah, Palau. Mm-hmm. And, uh, most of them fellas is all dead now. Oh, yeah. I wonder if you can tell us about the King Oliver. Is he remembering when you first heard him play? And when you worked with him and all about him?

When, uh, Oliver, Joe Oliver, when I first got Joe Oliver, he only could play brass band music. He couldn't play no dance music. He had a, he had a, uh, a shoe shop uptown repairing shoes. Joe did that? Joe Oliver. He didn't know any of them. Yeah, and I, I went to hire him to play a dance up on St. Charles Street with me. I had the job and he told me that, uh, uh, he wasn't able to play no dance music. But he would get me somebody called, uh, John Peniton, I think it is. He was a trombone player, but he couldn't…
Yeah. But sometime he would play in the brass band, he played baritone. Yeah.
